snippet.title: Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss | Investigation Trailer
snippet.description:
The Ocean-I station is the first point of contact, still standing at the edge of the abyss: Its crew vanished, its systems continue to run, and whatever happened here never reached the surface.

This is where your next Lovecraftian investigation begins.

Cthulhu: The Cosmic Abyss is coming to PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S on April, 16th 2026.
